title: A high protected fraction does not certify survival during irreversible capping
statement: For unfinished states U(unmasked),H(protected),damage U->D at c_U, mask U->H at a and opening H->U at b, Q=[[-a-c_U,a],[b,-b]]. Starting pi=[b/(a+b),a/(a+b)] with maintained mask gives S_U(t)=pi*exp(Q*t)*1 and dS_U/dt=-c_U*P(U,t). An independent completed-site cap at c_P gives joint desired probability(1-exp(-c_P*t))*S_U(t), not merely the equilibrium protected fraction.

requires: Finite nonnegative a,b,c_U,c_P,t with a+b>0; specified initial binding equilibrium and maintained mask during cap.
Pair-product requires independent site evolutions and supplied completed-site cap rate under the same prescribed exposure.

No actual selective dense-scaffold cap/demask, harmless cleanup, rate or joint independence is acquired.

body: The row sums of Q are(-c_U,0), so multiplying the transient probability row by Q*1 gives the integrated irreversible-loss flux. Protection occupancy at a single time is not survival accumulated across openings. The source explicitly begins at binding equilibrium and maintains masking reagent during cap; preparing every site protected or removing mask changes the initial/process law. The pair-product additionally assumes independent unfinished/completed evolution under the prescribed exposure, not shared chemical depletion or damage. At b=0 with initial H and a>0, survival is1; with actual openings and c_U>0 the flux can accumulate even when a/(a+b) is close to1. Capping time must also satisfy completed-site success, followed by cap clearance and deliberate demasking. Hydroxylamine/thioester separation, root competence and selective trigger chemistry remain unacquired. The8.60e-7/s illustrative ceiling and13-day lifetime are parameter-screen reports, not measured mask behavior or universal thresholds.
